title: US5023200 Formation of multiple levels of porous silicon for buried insulators and conductors in silicon device technologies; search also surfaced US6362079 (anodization method) and US8470689 (multilayer structure)
query: porous silicon selective anodization p+ layers multilayer epitaxial stack 3D DRAM alternative to SiGe sacrificial
supports: Multi-level porous-Si buried insulators from p+/n epi stacks are old patent art. Porous Si etches far more selectively than SiGe. A 1990s patent warns that holes leak from a deeper p+ layer into the barrier layer, so anodization loses selectivity unless the shallowest layer is done first; buried n+ anodization gives more uniform islands. No 3D DRAM application found (via search snippet)

title: imec: A novel DRAM memory cell with two IGZO-based transistors (also eeNews Europe, KU Leuven MICAS 2T0C noise-immunity talk)

query: IGZO sense amplifier all-oxide periphery 2T0C DRAM macro monolithic BEOL without silicon CMOS
supports: 2T0C IGZO cells are integrated in the BEOL above Si periphery; oxide semiconductors are inherently n-type, so 2T0C uses two n-FETs. No all-oxide (IGZO-only) sense amplifier or periphery surfaced; IMECAS, Macronix and Peking University publish 2T0C/CAA variants (via search snippet; negative result from one search)
